text: RESULTS: Spirometry: FEV1 65% of predicted, FVC 78% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio 0.60 (reduced)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (likely exacerbated by environmental factors or underlying atopy, despite the MS diagnosis). The reduced FEV1/FVC ratio with preserved FVC and the presence of wheezing are classic for obstructive airway disease. Given the chronic nature and lack of systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, an acute infection or malignancy is less likely.
